title: long form errors banner plus inline
rule: Long/complex form errors: critical banner at top + move focus to it + inline field errors. Dual-cite with GOV.UK error summary.
pass_when: Long/complex form: critical banner at top, focus moves to it, plus inline field errors.
fail_when: Banner only, inline only, or focus not moved to the banner.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil; MULTI_HOME picked explain_failure_next_to_cause; leftover harvest tag recover_from_invalid_input
do_not_claim: A winner vs GOV.UK error summary; dropping either summary/banner or inline (`forms.errors.next_to_field_not_summary_only`). Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.next_to_field_not_summary_only` + `forms.errors.focus_first_error`.
